purpose: Wavelength-pivoted symmetric PCM pair evaluated at the measured 1550-nm endpoint indices

source_material.paper: Delaney et al., Advanced Functional Materials 2020, DOI:10.1002/adfm.202002447
source_material.limitations: Endpoint k values are reported as zero at 1550 nm; intermediate states and crystalline anisotropy are idealized.

geometry_policy.upper_and_lower_hcg_geometry: exact M58D mirror pair, analytically rescaled to 1550 nm
geometry_policy.publication_claim: idealized symmetric PCM pilot, pending independent material and fabrication validation
